title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - User
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/User. An entity using a wearable, defined as a saref:FeatureOfInterest for which an interactsWith relationship with a WearableDevice exists (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.2). Distinct from Wearer: a User interacts with a device (e.g. operating its controls) without necessarily being sensed by it, as in the audio-control-wearable example of TS 103 410-9 Figure 10.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'User'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

interactsWith.description: Relationship. Wearable device(s) this user interacts with; definitional for the User class (s4wear:interactsWith). Links to one or more WearableDevice entities.
